data.body: S2 6cd0 CLOSED (change 2242 merged as 1efc5ebb57dd, which IS origin/main). Merge conflict resolved en route: my branch carried a STALE local copy of S1 because Gerrit's Rebase-If-Necessary landed 2237 under a different sha, so c46166e920db was never an ancestor of origin/main; rebased --onto origin/main c46166e920db to drop the duplicate and replay S2 alone. Two conflicts, both foreseen: docs/env-vars.md (generated) and gate_dispatch.py (independent imports, both kept sorted). Bonus: main had extracted a completion_metrics cluster for the same module-size pressure I flagged, so gate_dispatch.py went 800 -> 745. Also learned the chained review+close exceeds the execution limit — must run as separate commands. S3 26ae now UNBLOCKED.
